folds.title: What effort means
points: **Effort** is how much work Claude puts into an answer.
It covers how long Claude thinks and how carefully it checks.
Higher effort is slower and uses more of your allowance.

folds.title: Lower or higher?
points: **Lower effort**: quick answers for simple jobs, like chat or short tasks.
**Higher effort**: tricky problems, long tasks and careful work.
For simple jobs, lower effort is faster and saves usage.

chat.label: Lower effort is fine
chat.you: Suggest a name for my goldfish.
chat.claude: How about Bubbles, Finn or Captain Splash?

chat.label: Higher effort helps
chat.you: Plan a two-week trip on a tight budget.
chat.claude: I compared routes, stays and costs, and kept some spare for surprises.

folds.title: How to choose
items: Start with the default model and effort.
Answer too shallow? Step up the model or the effort.
Quick, simple job? Step down to save usage.
Change one thing at a time, so you see what helped.

folds.prompt: Lower or higher effort? Tap the basket.

items.why: Simple chat needs no deep thought.

items.why: Hard problems are where extra effort pays off.
